headline: Cisco patches root-privilege zero-day in Secure Email Gateway
summary: Cisco patched an actively exploited zero-day in its Secure Email Gateway that let remote, unauthenticated attackers execute commands with root privileges, with both Cisco and CISA warning about the flaw.

claims.statement: Cisco patched an actively exploited zero-day in its Secure Email Gateway allowing remote unauthenticated attackers to execute commands with root privileges.

sources.quote: Cisco has patched another actively exploited zero-day flaw in its Secure Email Gateway (SEG) that lets remote unauthenticated attackers execute commands with root privileges
Cisco make-me-root email bug exploited as a 0-day by unknown crims

claims.statement: Both Cisco and CISA issued warnings about the flaw.

sources.quote: Both Switchzilla and CISA sound the alarm
